thought.text: Data lengkap. Saya cek satu hal terakhir: apakah bisa daftar dengan email non-Google dan captcha apa.

action.command: cd /workspace/project && curl -s --max-time 30 "https://venice.ai/signup" -o /tmp/vs.html -w "[%{http_code}] "; grep -oiE "(turnstile|recaptcha|hcaptcha|sitekey|0x4AAAAA|6L[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{20,})" /tmp/vs.html | sort -u | head -8; echo "=== api auth endpoints ==="; for p in "/api/auth/signup" "/api/auth/sign-up" "/api/v1/auth/signup"; do printf "%-24s " "$p"; curl -s --max-time 20 -X POST "https://api.venice.ai$p" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{}' -w " [%{http_code}]" | head -c 100; echo; done

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace/project && curl -s --max-time 30 \"https://venice.ai/signup\" -o /tmp/vs.html -w \"[%{http_code}] \"; grep -oiE \"(turnstile|recaptcha|hcaptcha|sitekey|0x4AAAAA|6L[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{20,})\" /tmp/vs.html | sort -u | head -8; echo \"=== api auth endpoints ===\"; for p in \"/api/auth/signup\" \"/api/auth/sign-up\" \"/api/v1/auth/signup\"; do printf \"%-24s \" \"$p\"; curl -s --max-time 20 -X POST \"https://api.venice.ai$p\" -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" -d '{}' -w \" [%{http_code}]\" | head -c 100; echo; done", "summary": "Check Venice signup captcha type", "security_risk": "LOW", "timeout": 150}
